codes.detail: No response from flue non-return flap or condensate pump defective

codes.title: Interruption to DHW outlet sensor at external controller
codes.detail: UK link box is connected, but hot water NTC not bridged

codes.title: Flow and/or return temperature sesnsor temperature change fault
codes.detail: When the burner starts, the temperature change registered at flow and/or return temperature sensor is non-existant or too small. Not enough water in the boiler Flow and/or return temperature sensor not in correct position at pipe

codes.title: Fault: Flow/return temperature sensor difference implausible
codes.detail: Flow and return temperature sensors return implausible values - Flow and return temperature sensors have been inverted - Flow and return temperature sensors have not been correctly fitted

codes.title: Fault: Flow and return temperature sensors incorrectly fitted
codes.detail: Flow and/or return temperature sensors have been fitted to the same pipe/wrong pipe

codes.title: Coding resistor fault
codes.detail: The coding resistor on the PCB does not match the entered gas family. Check the resistor, repeat the gas family check and enter the correct gas family.

codes.title: Gas group fault
codes.detail: Combustion quality outside the permitted range: Wrong gas restrictor, recirculation, wrong gas family, internal pressure measuring point in ven- turi blocked (do not use lubricant on O-ring in venturi.). Gas family check prematurely terminated.

codes.title: All-gas / CO sensor defective or short-circuited
codes.detail: Check plug, cable harness, sensor, and PCB. Recovered from the later Vaillant table on hub.myboiler.com.

codes.title: actoSTOR inlet sensor defective or not connected
codes.detail: Only in combination with F.91: check NTC, plug, cable harness, PCB.

codes.title: Cylinder charging pump — cylinder not fully charged in time
codes.detail: Only in combination with F.91: check sensors, impeller, diverter valve, pump, secondary heat exchanger.

codes.title: External current anode defective or not connected
codes.detail: Check cable harness and anode. If no anode is fitted, fit the X43 bridge on the PCB.

codes.title: Communication with actoSTOR interrupted
codes.detail: Check eBUS cable to the actoSTOR module. If running without actoSTOR, set D.092=0.

codes.title: actoSTOR sensor fault
codes.detail: Check plug, cable harness, and sensor.

codes.title: Vortex and differential pressure sensors implausible
codes.detail: Check cable harness, plug, and sensors.

codes.title: Hot water NTC sensor defective.
codes.detail: Check hot water NTC sensor and connecting lead for circuit breaks/short circuits.

codes.title: Break in communication to TD200 or/and RT10.
codes.detail: Check electrical connections.

codes.title: Code plug not detected.
codes.detail: Insert code plug correctly, test and replace if necessary.

codes.title: Fan speed too low.
codes.detail: Check fan lead and connector, and fan; replace as necessary.

codes.title: CH flow NTC sensor defective.
codes.detail: Check CH flow NTC sensor and connecting lead.

codes.title: Safety temp. limiter in CH flow has tripped.
codes.detail: Check system pressure, check safety temp. limiters, check pump operation, check fuse on pcb, bleed appli- ance.

codes.title: Flame not detected.
codes.detail: Is gas cock turned on? Check gas supply pressure, power supply, igniter electrode and lead, ionisation sensing electrode and lead, flue duct and C02 level.

codes.title: Internal error.
codes.detail: Check electrical connector contacts, programmer inter- face module ignition leads are not loose; replace pcb if necessary.

codes.title: Flame detected even though appliance switched off.
codes.detail: Check electrode assembly, dry pcb. Flue clear?

codes.title: Flame detected after gas shut off.
codes.detail: Check gas valve and wiring to gas valve. Clean conden- sation trap and check electrode assembly. Flue clear?

codes.title: Reset button pressed by mistake.
codes.detail: Press reset button again.

codes.title: Siphon fill mode
codes.detail: Wait about 15 minutes. If it continues for more than half an hour, call an engineer.
